construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)
candidate_note: LOCKED corpus ×50 (k2 cell 2026-08-19; chips and ledger 2026-09-04); k2_card registers remain an unauthored stub.
sources: REA_03 §4b (interaction seeds — parsed from the doc)

candidates.structural_interaction: Fire directing Metal cross-polarity — focused warmth shaping the edge with discipline
candidates.k2_overview: Your Metal moves as the Steward: an edge in service of what it keeps. You maintain value with a craftsman’s discipline, tools oiled, accounts true, promises weighed before signing. Nothing gaudy, everything durable. What passes through your hands leaves better organized, and what stays becomes quietly excellent.
candidates.k2_functional: You execute with clean precision: zero waste, nothing reworked, every screw accounted for.

k2_domain_readings.Wealth: Your wealth is machined: earned exactly, kept polished, compounded without drama. You are never flashy about money, and you hate not knowing where it went. Buy the thing that still earns its place a year on, and treat your own skills the same way.
k2_domain_readings.Savings: You save like an armorer: reserves as protection, kept bright and counted. The vault serves the life, so define what it defends, and spend without guilt inside those lines.
k2_domain_readings.Steady love: You love in maintained condition: reliability, kept promises, care with no rust on it. Choose someone who values upkeep, then schedule delight as faithfully as inspections.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the edge runs thin and you take on little. Each piece you pick up is carried to its end.

angles.drive: Finishing things settles you more than starting them. You carry an open task until it is closed, so you finish what you hold before starting anything new. Anything put in your hands comes back done.
angles.cost_self: Proof that you are reliable comes from finishing things. You finish whatever is nearest rather than whatever matters most, since finished is the feeling you are after. Your big plans wait at the bottom of a tidy list.
angles.cost_others: For other people, you finish things too. You finish the last steps of a shared plan rather than wait for the others, since waiting feels like leaving it undone. The others lose the small pride of closing what they began.

angles.drive: Your reflex with money is saving first. You feel a sum set aside cannot be lost, so you save rather than spend, and spend only what is left. Those who depend on you never meet a bad month unprotected.
angles.cost_self: Saving first keeps away the fear of having nothing. You put the saving ahead of what it was for, and you move the wanting to later. Your own pleasures wait in an account that grows while the years go by.
angles.cost_others: You save first for the people you love as much as for yourself. You save for a shared future rather than spend on a shared present, and call that love. Evenings out with you are rare, however secure the years ahead.

angles.drive: You stand by people through the lean years as well as the good ones. Being someone others can count on matters more to you than being exciting, and you stay when staying is dull. Old friends still call you first.
angles.cost_self: Standing by people means staying through their worst stretches. You need a bond to last more than you need it to be easy, and you keep showing up long after it stops being returned. Some years your loyalty costs you more than it brings back.
angles.cost_others: You stand by the people you have had for years. You need the old ties to stay strong, and newer faces take a long time to get in. Those who arrive late find a warm circle that is already full.

friction.define: As a friction, what you own starts to own you. A loss weighs more with you than any gain.

angles.drive: Holding on tight makes what you have feel safe. You would rather keep a thing than risk losing it, and you grip money, things and people past where holding helps. You have every right to let go of what you no longer want.
angles.cost_self: The fear of loss goes quiet while you are holding tight. You keep hold of the savings rather than spend them on their year, since spending feels exposed. Holding on costs you trips not taken, with the money outliving its purpose.
angles.cost_others: Holding on tight reaches the people you love too. You hold the person you love the way you hold a sum, close and counted, rather than give them slack. You leave the person beside you no air when you hold on this tight.

angles.drive: Your default with cost is playing it safe. You feel a loss more than a gain the same size, and you play safe for the small sure return rather than the big one. Playing safe costs you too, slower and in money you never count.
angles.cost_self: Playing it safe keeps you out of the loss column and the win column. You take the known small wage rather than the unknown better one, since playing safe is never judged. You pay for playing it safe in the chance you watched others take.
angles.cost_others: For the ones you love, playing safe is the rule too. You keep the person you love on the safe plan rather than the one they wanted, since their risk feels like yours. You take from them the risks that were theirs to choose.

angles.drive: Keeping what works means avoiding change. You know the price of what you have and not of the better, and you keep the known rather than try a change. Long after the known stops paying you, you go on avoiding change.
angles.cost_self: Avoiding change spares you being new at anything. You keep the steady job and the steady love after they stop feeding you rather than change either. Avoiding change costs you the better life you never tried.
angles.cost_others: Where you avoid change, you avoid it for others too. The old plan is the one you trust, and you keep the people close to you inside it instead of letting them change it. You miss the new starts they wanted to make with you.

retired_2026-09-20_batch3.k2_domain_readings.Wealth: Your wealth is machined: earned exactly, kept polished, compounded without drama. You will never be flashy and never be broke. Invest in quality that holds its edge, including your own skills.
retired_2026-09-20_batch3.fn_reading.catalyst.Thorough.outside: People hand you things that must not be gotten wrong: the visa application, the medication schedule, the wedding planning. Errors approach your work and give up early. The double-checkers who review you have quietly stopped, a professional courtesy extended to perhaps three people they have ever met.

edge.lead: Metal runs through your wealth, your family and your career. It is the money you set aside each month that earns while you sleep, the home where the spare key is on its hook, and the small print you read right to the end.
